The +111 price clears the model's fair odds of -144, and the directional case survives the opportunity sensitivity range. No sourced report directly addresses Finnie.","model_case":"The projected mean of 1.42 shots against a 1.5 line, on 15.6 projected minutes, carries the under. The weakness is that the margin is small, so a modest role or power-play bump moves the mean over 1.5. Even the high-opportunity sensitivity case still stays above break-even.","price_case":"This is a single main line at +111, which needs roughly even-money-plus accuracy to break even. Only one other book is quoted, so this is not broad consensus. The blended view is much closer to the market. Settlement rules are assumed standard and have not been checked for this book.","context_case":"Detroit has several forwards listed on IR, which could lift Finnie's minutes or special-teams usage and push shot volume toward the line. His own role and active status remain unverified.","blocking_checks":[]},"countercase":"With centers sidelined, Finnie may be promoted to a scoring line or the power play. That would raise his shot volume above the 15.6-minute assumption, and a one-shot cushion is easily erased. One other book is thin confirmation that the market is mispriced rather than the model.","open_checks":["Confirm Finnie's line and power-play assignment at morning skate","Confirm BetOnline settlement rules for player shots","Reconfirm +111 is still available before the 7:10 PM EDT puck drop"],"evidence":[{"source_id":"b96a2cbcf29ff7f6f4be","excerpt":"Marco Kasper (C); Upper Body; IR. Expected to be out until at least Oct 20","interpretation":"If Kasper and other listed Detroit forwards are out, Finnie could absorb extra minutes or power-play time. That would work against the under. The snapshot is not game-day confirmation.","kind":"injury","direction":"concern","represented_in":"unknown"}]},{"candidate_id":"42f5feb627284134b40155cf","status":"needs_information","assessment":{"verdict":"consider","reason":"The under is projected to lose more often than win, but +150 sets a low break-even. The model's estimate stays above it across the sensitivity range, and multiple books are quoted with published rules.","model_case":"The projected mean of 1.81 shots on 16.7 minutes exceeds the 1.5 line, so this is a price play, not a likely-under play. The weakness is that any role increase pushes the mean higher. Even the high-opportunity sensitivity case still stays above break-even.","price_case":"This is a main line at +150, which requires winning about two in five to break even. The model's fair odds are about +112. Three other books are quoted, which gives better coverage than a single book. The blended estimate narrows the gap considerably.","context_case":"Winnipeg is missing listed defensemen and forwards, which may enlarge Perfetti's power-play role. Carolina's listed absences could also shift possession toward Winnipeg. Both effects lean against the under, and neither is confirmed in lineups.","blocking_checks":[]},"countercase":"With Morrissey and Namestnikov listed out, Perfetti could take on heavier power-play duty. Winnipeg may also control play against a depleted Carolina lineup. Both would lift his shot volume beyond 1.81, eroding the narrow price edge. The market's shorter under price may already reflect this.","open_checks":["Confirm Perfetti's power-play unit and line at morning skate","Check whether Namestnikov's absence changes Winnipeg's center deployment","Reconfirm +150 before the 3:40 PM EDT start"],"evidence":[{"source_id":"5c732d1d1b0a239bf3de","excerpt":"Josh Morrissey (D); Wrist; Expected to be out until at least Oct 22","interpretation":"If Morrissey misses the game, Winnipeg's power-play structure may change. That could increase Perfetti's shot opportunities, which works against the under. The snapshot is not confirmation.","kind":"injury","direction":"concern","represented_in":"unknown"}]},{"candidate_id":"a0af65c3716186784e7b76a5","status":"concern","assessment":{"verdict":"pass","reason":"The +105 price sits essentially at the model's minimum acceptable odds of about +105. The model's goalie mix weights Shesterkin heavily, yet he is listed on IR. Settlement rules are also unchecked.","model_case":"The projected mean of 0.63 points against a 0.5 line on 17.9 minutes gives only a slight under lean. The goalie adjustment matters here. A weaker Rangers starter than assumed would raise Columbus scoring and erode the under's thin margin.","price_case":"This is a main line at +105, with break-even just under even odds. The low sensitivity case barely clears it. Any small price move or input change removes the cushion. Two other books are quoted.","context_case":"The injury table lists both Shesterkin and Korpisalo on IR, which conflicts with the model's goalie assumption. The listing is a snapshot with an odd return date, so the actual starter remains unverified.","blocking_checks":[]},"countercase":"The listing may be stale, and Shesterkin could start, restoring the modeled goalie mix. Even then, the edge is negligible at +105 and settlement is unverified. If a backup starts instead, Columbus scoring odds rise and the under weakens. Either way the case is not defensible at this price.","open_checks":["Confirm the Rangers' starting goalie and Shesterkin's actual status","Verify BetMGM settlement rules for player points","Check whether Coyle's line or power-play role has changed"],"evidence":[{"source_id":"5c06ff232b8a667840a5","excerpt":"Igor Shesterkin (G); Knee; IR. Expected to be out until at least Sep 15; updated Sun, Oct 11","interpretation":"If Shesterkin is unavailable, the model's goalie weighting would overstate the Rangers' save quality. A weaker starter would make a Coyle point more likely. The listing may be stale or inaccurate.","kind":"goalie","direction":"concern","represented_in":"unknown"}]}]}
